subject.title: Feature: Floating agent bubbles (Clawi) for macOS

question: Should OpenClaw’s native macOS app own a supported per-agent floating-overlay workflow, including persisted placement and selected-agent chat routing?
rationale: This is a new macOS interaction model with platform, session-routing, persistence, and accessibility boundaries; current adjacent UI does not define the product contract needed to scope a safe implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a native macOS overlay design
options.body: Define the agent-state source, selection and chat-routing behavior, persistence policy, and accessibility/window-management requirements, then scope implementation against that contract.

options.title: Keep existing macOS surfaces
options.body: Decline the floating-overlay direction and retain menu-bar and WebChat interactions as the supported native macOS workflow.

options.title: Expose a future extension seam first
options.body: Prioritize a narrow native macOS overlay or session-selection API only if maintainers want third parties to implement the experience outside the core app.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a native macOS overlay design
recommendation.body: Define the agent-state source, selection and chat-routing behavior, persistence policy, and accessibility/window-management requirements, then scope implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history places this person closest to the adjacent macOS activity, HUD, and chat-manager ownership boundaries.
